**Overview:**  
Unity Global Trading Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited retailer of textiles and baju kurung based in Selangor, Malaysia. The company was incorporated on 15 June 2018 and is currently active with five directors; Director 4 is the major shareholder with a 58.25% stake and, together with Director 5, was appointed within the past six months. No corporate shareholders are recorded. Financial statements for 2022‑2024 show unqualified audit opinions and modest profitability.
